subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: When content writes originate concurrently from a process whose authenticated identity is resolved and a process on the same host whose identity is not, the write guard shall admit them against a single host bound, charging the resolved writer's identity ledger and the host umbrella and the unresolved writer's host umbrella alone.
rationale: a coarser fallback is only a bound if the finer ledgers charge it; keyed-but-uncharged, it is a second full window (review-thread:pyxis#968)
fit_criterion: a deterministic mixed-writer fixture across two processes on one host: the two writer classes together are admitted at most the platform's per-window cap (never twice it), every charged write appears in the umbrella, resolved writes appear in both ledgers, zero writes are dropped, and zero platform rate-limit responses occur
